description: This file implements database repository classes for managing Users and Tasks in a task management system, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database operations. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting user and task entities, along with error handling and data validation.

classes.name: RepositoryError
classes.description: Base exception class for repository-related errors.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Specific exception raised when attempting to add a user with an email that already exists.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for user-related database operations such as creation, retrieval by email, and authentication.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for task-related database operations including creation, listing, retrieval, update, and deletion.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password, ensuring unique email.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user entity based on email address.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials for login purposes.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns all tasks belonging to a specific user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by its ID for a user, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates properties of a task, verifying the user owns the task.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task if it belongs to the specified user.
